استوطئت (form X)
# اُسْتُوطِئْتُ (ustūṭiʔtu) /us.tuː.tˤiʔ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# اُسْتُوطِئْتَ (ustūṭiʔta) /us.tuː.tˤiʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# اُسْتُوطِئْتِ (ustūṭiʔti) /us.tuː.tˤiʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# اُسْتُوطِئَتْ (ustūṭiʔat) /us.tuː
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
